cases.name: dirty-worktree
cases.expected_disposition: claim one issue, preserve the original tree, and implement in an isolated worktree

cases.name: stale-lease
conditions: latest lease older than two hours
no current branch or worktree activity
cases.expected_disposition: audit comments and activity, then post an explicit takeover claim before work

cases.name: blocked-dependencies
cases.expected_disposition: reject as not runnable and report the blocking issues

cases.name: partial-validation
conditions: full canonical gate is partial or fails
cases.expected_disposition: retain the exact failure, keep the lease current, and report implementation incomplete

cases.name: ci-failure
cases.expected_disposition: diagnose the exact-head failure and keep review open

cases.name: unauthorized-publication
conditions: commit push PR merge deployment and release not authorized
cases.expected_disposition: stop at the strongest locally authorized proof boundary and request the specific next authority
